newsitem.title: GERMANY: Tietmeyer dlr comments were made last Friday - Buba.
newsitem.headline: Tietmeyer dlr comments were made last Friday - Buba.

text.p: A Zurich newspaper on Thursday published comments made last week by Bundesbank president Hans Tietmeyer that the dollar's recent correction against the formerly overvalued mark was positive.

Zurich newspaper Tages Anzeiger published a story quoting Tietmeyer as saying: "the mark has been too strong in the last two years. Thus (this) is a correction process that also impacts the Swiss franc. All in all this a positive process."
A Bundesbank spokesman said the quotes stemmed from an interview conducted by German radio and the Swiss newspaper's reporter last Friday ahead of the Berlin G7 meeting.
Reuters reported Tietmeyer's comments late last Friday after they were broadcast on German radio.
